
# Bacus Explorer Support

Welcome to Bacus Explorer support.

## Where to Get Help

### Bugs

Use GitHub Issues and select the Bug Report template.

### Feature Requests

Use the Feature Request template.

### General Questions

Use GitHub Discussions:

https://github.com/ciberspar/bacus-explorer/discussions

### Security Problems

Use private vulnerability reporting:

https://github.com/ciberspar/bacus-explorer/security/advisories/new

Do not publish sensitive security details publicly.

## Before Asking for Help

Please provide:

- Bacus Explorer version.
- Operating system.
- Relevant error messages.
- Steps to reproduce the problem.

Remove passwords, tokens and private information from logs.

## Support Scope

The first development target is Linux Mint 22.3 MATE.

Other Linux distributions may be supported as development progresses.
